slides.headline: STUDENT VISAS RARELY FAIL ON ACADEMICS.
slides.sub: They fail on money and paperwork.
slides.note: The offer is the easy part. Evidencing it correctly is where applications come apart.

slides.headline: WHY APPLICATIONS FACE PROBLEMS
items: Insufficient funds for the required period
Funds not held for the correct length of time
Bank documents that do not meet the format required
Missing sponsorship evidence where funds are not your own
Details that do not match the CAS
Missing certificates where the course or country requires them

slides.answer: HAVING THE MONEY IS NOT ENOUGH.
slides.body: You have to prove it in the exact form required — right account, right period, right documentation.
slides.note: This is where otherwise strong applications quietly fail.

slides.headline: WHAT MAY BE REQUIRED
items: Financial evidence in the required format
Previous education documents listed on your CAS
Parental consent and birth certificate for under-18s
slides.footnote: Requirements vary by course, country of residence and profile.
